jobs.name: SeaLion
jobs.prompt: The TOP of the attached image is the approved design of a CALIFORNIA SEA LION; the strip at the BOTTOM only shows the game's art style (do not copy its fish). Redraw the creature from the top as ONE clean model sheet for 3D conversion: chunky stylized low-poly game art, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors, soft even lighting, a touch more realistic in proportion than a toy, with the same shape, colors and markings as the design at the top.
